title: Accordion
description: A collapsible content panel component supporting single or multiple expanded items, keyboard navigation, and persistent state.

selectionMode.description: Only one item can be expanded at a time.

collapsible.description: Whether the expanded item can be collapsed by clicking it again.

defaultValue.description: Initial expanded item value for uncontrolled usage.

selectionMode.description: Multiple items can be expanded simultaneously.

maxExpanded.description: Maximum number of simultaneously expanded items.

value.description: Controlled list of expanded item values.

defaultValue.description: Initial expanded item values for uncontrolled usage.

selectionMode.description: Selection mode: single or multiple expanded items.

dir.description: Text direction. Reverses the horizontal arrow keys and sets `dir` on the root; the layout itself does not mirror.

loop.description: Whether keyboard navigation wraps from last to first item.

classes.description: CSS class overrides for accordion sub-elements.

headingLevel.description: HTML heading level for accordion item triggers.

asChild.description: Merges accordion props onto a child element via Slot.

animationEasing.description: CSS easing function for expand/collapse animation.

animationDuration.description: Duration in milliseconds for expand/collapse animation.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects OS setting.

defaultExpandAll.description: Expands all items on initial render.

storageKey.description: Key or config for persisting expanded state to storage.

onKeyDown.x-tsType: ((event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>, itemValue: string | null) => void) | undefined

preventCloseTimeout.description: Timeout in ms for the preventClose callback.

aria-busy.description: ARIA busy state for async content.

announceExpanded.description: Announces expanded state changes to screen readers.

value.description: Identifies this item. Matches the values passed to the accordion's `value` or `defaultValue`.

disabled.description: Disables this item alone. It stays visible but cannot be toggled and leaves the tab order.

asChild.description: Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props.

onExpandedChange.description: Fires when the item's expanded state changes.

aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

expandedIcon.description: Icon shown while the item is expanded. Replaces the default chevron.

collapsedIcon.description: Icon shown while the item is collapsed. Replaces the default chevron.

iconPosition.description: Which end of the trigger the icon sits at — `start` before the text, `end` after it — or `"none"` to drop it.

asChild.description: Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props.

subtitle.description: Secondary line rendered under the trigger's label.

iconAnimation.description: How the icon changes on toggle: rotate the chevron, switch between the two icons, or neither.

leftSlot.description: Content placed before the label, inside the trigger.

rightSlot.description: Content placed after the label and before the icon.

aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

keepMounted.description: When the panel's children are in the DOM. `"visited"` (default): from the first expand onward. `true`: always, even before the first expand, so an exit animation or a measurement has a node to read. `false`: only while expanded — they unmount each time it collapses.

animationDuration.description: Expand and collapse duration in milliseconds.

animationEasing.description: CSS easing function for the expand and collapse transition.

asChild.description: Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props.

lazyLoad.description: Delays rendering the panel's children until it is first expanded.

onOpenStart.description: Fires when the expand transition begins.

onOpenEnd.description: Fires when the expand transition finishes.

onCloseStart.description: Fires when the collapse transition begins.

onCloseEnd.description: Fires when the collapse transition finishes.

reduceMotion.description: Whether to stop the shimmer animation. `"auto"` follows the OS reduced-motion setting.

classes.description: Class overrides for this component's slots.

unstyled.description: Drops the decorative default classes and keeps the structural ones, along with focus, keyboard and ARIA wiring.

count.description: How many placeholder items to draw.

size.description: Matches the accordion size the placeholder stands in for.

variant.description: Matches the accordion variant the placeholder stands in for.

animate.description: Whether the placeholder pulses. Set false for a still skeleton.

className.description: Additional classes for the root element.

style.description: Inline styles for the root element.

showContent.description: Also draws a placeholder for the expanded panel, not just the triggers.

asChild.description: Render the passed child instead of the default element, keeping behaviour, ARIA and props.
